mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing foggy conditions and a temperature of 72 degrees at Verona Community Park.

The Verona Senior Center has announced that they will be closed for flooring updates starting September 1, with limited services available on certain dates before a reopening on September 10. Additionally, crews are currently repairing a water main break near Todd Street that is affecting local service.

There is plenty to do with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee both taking place today. Looking forward to tomorrow, you can enjoy the downtown farmer's market, yoga at Insight Wellness, or evening trivia at The Bogey Factory.
On August 25, officers were dispatched to a medical emergency on Enterprise Drive where they successfully used an AED to restore a pulse to a local resident.
Today's flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by later to enjoy a scoop.
